description: The culture festival's stage shows in BUNKA_SD.EXN (state 0x80): the five speech-contest speeches with their titles and speaker names, the Drama Club's plays Kintaro Samurai, Romeo and Julietta and Quiz Squadron Cultman, and their speaker labels (298 lines). Each line is a `bytes` patch made by tools/prefixed_lines.py from extracted/tables/BUNKA_SD.json: the prefix byte (' ' more lines, 'g' end of page, 'E' end of show) kept raw, the English pair-encoded in the line's own room, trailing full-width spaces kept as far as they fit (game-internals 6ab). The blank pause lines stay. Verified in DuckStation on forced festival days (force_festival.py --club 1 --year 0/1/2, --club 0 --year 2; hidden emulator; testing.md 'The culture festival'): all three plays and Shiori's speech. Checked only statically: the other four speeches.
